name: UL FRI FRIDA modular containerised data centre / supercomputer
developer: University of Ljubljana, Faculty of Computer and Information Science (FRI); NTR Inzeniring
notes: Modular containerised rooftop data centre at FRI Ljubljana housing the FRIDA supercomputer for AI/LLM development; hybrid air+direct liquid cooling; launched/inaugurated June 2026 (upgrades first-round 'planned' DCD 2025-01 report of ~EUR 2.5m NTR project). MW capacity not published.

name: ARNES Ljubljana-area redundancy data centre (planned)
notes: ARNES official page (2024-06-18) states plans include construction of another data centre in the surroundings of Ljubljana to provide redundancy for ARNES services; location, timeline and capacity not disclosed.

name: Posita Ljubljana Vic data center
notes: Posta Slovenije official page lists Ljubljana Vic as a data centre location with 500 kVA (0.5 MW) power capacity; directory lists address Cesta v Mestni log 81. Commercial/public-sector colocation, 99.982% availability claim.

name: Posta Slovenije new data centre for Ministry of Digital Transformation (postal logistics centre)
notes: GOV.SI confirms Posta Slovenije handed a new data centre at the Ljubljana postal-logistics centre to the Ministry of Digital Transformation on 2025-09-30 (third DC leased to the ministry since 2005); Forbes reporting says the ministry's DCs sit at three locations - two in Ljubljana, one in Maribor. MW capacity not disclosed.

name: Datacenter.si / RvO DC01 Ljubljana Center
notes: Datacenter.si official page lists Ljubljana - Center colocation (fire suppression, independent power); directory lists DC01 at Dunajska cesta 5, Ljubljana. Capacity not public.

name: Datacenter.si / RvO DC02 Ljubljana Technology Park / SIX
notes: Datacenter.si official page lists Ljubljana - Tehnoloski Park 18 - SIX colocation; RvO Technology Park page describes cloud/colocation/internet at Tehnoloski Park Ljubljana. Colocation near SIX Slovenian Internet Exchange. Capacity not public.

name: ARNES Ljubljana Technology Park data centre (Tehnoloski park 18)

name: ARNES Maribor Data Centre / Slovenian AI Factory (SLAIF)
notes: Site bought near Dravske elektrarne Maribor (Mariborski otok hydro); foundation stone laid 2025-05-06 with PM Golob - 'the largest data centre in Slovenia'; construction under way, completion by 2026 (RRF/NextGenerationEU + Ministry of Higher Education funding); will host open-science storage, university/research colocation, new supercomputer and Slovenian AI Factory; waste-heat reuse for Maribor district heating and rooftop solar planned. MW capacity not disclosed.

name: Posita Maribor Tezno data center
notes: Posta Slovenije official page lists Maribor Tezno with 1.2 MVA power capacity; directory lists Partizanska cesta 54, Maribor. Posta expanded DC footprint to 1000+ m2 across Ljubljana and Maribor (Finance.si).

name: Posita Maribor Center data center
notes: Posta Slovenije official page lists Maribor Center with 300 kVA power capacity; directory lists Zagrebska cesta 106, Maribor.

name: IZUM Vega supercomputer data centre
notes: Vega (1020 compute nodes, 130,560 CPU cores, ~6.9 PFLOPS combined) installed at IZUM Maribor and launched April 2021; NTR contractor page reports up to 830 kW consumption with cooling under 50 kW (annual PUE < 1.06). Research-HPC facility; capacity_mw=0.83 derived from contractor figure.
